profile_text.body:
Fireflies.ai is a Miami, Florida-based company that describes itself as the "#1 AI Teammate for Meetings, Email, Chat & CRM." According to its website, the product takes notes, manages tasks, and automates workflows across meetings, email, chat, CRM, and other applications, with the stated goal of building a searchable knowledge base of a team's work in one place.

The core product, tracked under the Notes, Knowledge & Meetings category, centers on an AI meeting assistant identified as "fred@fireflies.ai," which can be invited to live meetings or set to autojoin calendar meetings in order to record, transcribe, and summarize them. The site also describes a feature called AI Skills, which the company says can automatically extract key details, generate follow-up emails, score candidates, and surface other insights from meeting recordings.

The site's held facts flag Florida as the jurisdiction with the highest law exposure count at 50, which is relevant given that Florida is a two-party consent state for recording conversations, a consideration the site itself notes in connection with the product's meeting transcription functionality. No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are on record for the company at this time.
